about_the_game:
Infected Love: The Fatal Experiment

[Confessing Love on the Day of Infection]

Synopsis:

"When high school becomes a battlefield for survival… confessing your love might be the most important thing you do at the end of the world!"

You play as an ordinary student trapped inside an abandoned school that has become a nest of zombies.

Amid the groans and growls, and the creeping shadows closing in, you must join forces with classmates of vastly different personalities, uncover the truth behind a failed “secret experiment”, and make life-changing decisions that will lead you toward love… or death.

This is a story that will make your heart race — from both romance and zombies!

Key Gameplay & Features

Branching Storyline

Every choice you make will shape the fate of the characters. A single decision could mean the difference between survival and loss — or unlock a one-of-a-kind romantic ending.

Relationship System

Build deep bonds with your teammates through conversations, acts of support, and standing by their side in moments of crisis. Trust is the key to revealing their true selves… and perhaps finding love amidst the chaos.

Exploration & Clue-Finding

Search classrooms, the teacher’s lounge, the gym, the kitchen, the nurse’s office, and even the sealed-off laboratory to find supplies, hidden notes, and clues that connect to the experiment that caused this catastrophe.

Strategic Survival

You’re not just a bystander — you’re the one making the survival plan. Choose safe routes, manage scarce resources, and decide whether to risk everything to uncover the truth or retreat to keep your team alive.

Suspenseful Atmosphere

Echoing footsteps in empty halls, doors slowly creaking open on their own, and shadows shifting in the darkness — every step will make you feel like something is watching you.

Main Characters with Unique Abilities

- Luna – Sharp hearing and keen senses allow her to detect danger before anyone else. She’s the team’s natural radar for survival.

- Miya – Intelligent and cautious, she excels at planning and resource management, keeping the group alive efficiently.

- Scarlet – A charming “key master” who holds the keys to various rooms and knows the school’s hidden corners better than anyone.

- Kim – A tech-savvy nerd trying to restore contact with the outside world. His knowledge of communication devices and security systems is a vital lifeline.

"When love and death are separated by a single breath... who will be the one to hear your final love confession?"
